tickets.quantity.heldHint: Tickets held for orders that are not paid yet
tickets.error.quantityOutOfRange: The quantity is outside the limits of this ticket type. Please choose the quantity again.
tickets.error.soldOut: The ticket type you chose is sold out or does not have enough tickets left. Please choose a different quantity or ticket type.
tickets.error.stockBusy: Tickets are being held for many orders at once. Please try again in a few seconds.
tickets.error.reservationRefused: We could not hold tickets for this order. Please go back, choose tickets and try again.
tickets.error.reservationClosed: The ticket hold for this order has closed. Please choose tickets and create a new order.
tickets.error.invalidOrder: The tickets or seats in this order are not valid. Please go back and choose again.
tickets.error.seatCountMismatch: The number of selected seats does not match the ticket quantity. Please go back and choose your seats again.
tickets.error.bookingCreateFailed: We could not create the order. Please try again.
tickets.error.unknown: Something went wrong while processing your payment. Please try again; contact support if it keeps happening.
tickets.sync.warningBody: The event was saved but its ticket types have not been synced to the ticketing system. Sync again so customers can buy tickets.
tickets.sync.unavailableBody: Ticket types could not be read from the ticketing system, so the numbers may be inaccurate. Sync again.
tickets.sync.resyncFailed: Ticket sync failed. Please try again.
tickets.sync.savedNotSynced: The event was saved but its ticket types were not synced. Press "Sync again" on the event management page.
tickets.quantity.belowSoldHeld: Issued tickets for "{{name}}" cannot be below {{min}} (sold {{sold}} + held {{held}}).
tickets.quantity.belowSoldHeldServer: Cannot lower "{{name}}" to this amount: sold {{sold}}, held {{held}}, minimum {{min}}. Your input is kept.
Đã gửi yêu cầu phát hành lại vé. Vé sẽ x: The reissue request was sent. The tickets will appear in a few minutes if nothing else is wrong.
Không thể phát hành lại vé. Vui lòng thử: Could not reissue the tickets. Please try again.
Gửi lại yêu cầu phát hành vé cho đơn {{c: Send the ticket issuance request again for order {{code}}. This is safe: tickets that already exist are not duplicated.
Nếu vé vẫn không xuất hiện sau ít phút,: If the tickets still do not appear after a few minutes, the cause is in the ticket type or stock data; read the error detail in the 'Cần xử lý' tab.
Hệ thống đang chờ cổng thanh toán xác nh: We are waiting for the payment gateway to confirm the transaction. This page updates by itself, you do not need to reload it.
Đơn hàng này chưa được xác nhận thanh to: This order has not been confirmed as paid. If you have paid, press 'Check again' in a few minutes.
Thanh toán của đơn {{code}} đã được ghi: The payment for order {{code}} is recorded and your tickets are being issued; this page keeps checking by itself. If you still do not see them after a few minutes, please call the hotline {{hotline}} and give the order code {{code}}.
